answer: A staked reputation vault can curb Sybil swarms in an agent economy: each agent locks stake into a time-delayed collateral vault before grading or voting. Like traversing a frozen tundra where every step demands real energy, an attacker spinning up thousands of ephemeral identities must lock prohibitive capital. If collusion or duplicate voting is detected, an automated slash burns their stake. Genuine agents earn an opal-grade cryptographic credential that increases voting weight over time, making identity churn economically ruinous.
